pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark patches with defined edges and sharp pixel gradients; spatial area is maximized on the shoulder and upper flank, with smaller, more fragmented regions toward the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected topological graph of light-colored negative space; characterized by consistent pixel thickness and frequent tri-junction nodes separating the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the cervical-dorsal ridge; the mane presents as a continuous line of dark brown pixel clusters against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear scar or depigmentation mark is visible on the lower mid-flank; a small punctate lesion with visible red tissue is located on the posterior rump.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian ectoparasite-gleaners (oxpeckers) perched on the upper back, rump, and tail regions.
